svg.aria-label: Frequency responses of four window functions in decibels: the rectangular window has the narrowest main lobe but sidelobes only thirteen decibels down, Blackman-Harris has a much wider main lobe and sidelobes below ninety decibels
svg.text: peak sidelobe level, measured by DFT of a 64-point window
Narrow main lobe or low sidelobes — you cannot have both.
